learning_outcomes.text: After completing this module, students will know the technical fundamentals of computer science, both concerning the theoretical aspects of Boolean algebra and the electronic fundamentals. They will know methods for the design and optimization of digital circuits.
Students who have successfully completed this module are able to analyze, minimize, and implement logical functions in digital circuits at the gate level.
Students who have successfully completed this module are able to design and use basic digital circuits and synchronous circuits.
Students who have successfully completed this module are able to transform numbers into different representations and process them with arithmetic circuits.
Students who have successfully completed this module are able to select a suitable realization of digital circuits, considering the electronic fundamentals.
After completing the module, students can design and optimize digital circuits, select suitable realizations, and present and discuss the procedure.

assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam (Klausur) as per the valid study regulations. There is also an ungraded experimental work component consisting of approximately 5 experiments.
